skygo --json state retention enable --data-dir $DATA --request-window 1h
retention-domain DOMAIN
server start
taskfile task.json success
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id p1 --wait
job-id FIRST
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id p2 --wait
job-id SECOND
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id p3 --wait
job-id THIRD
# A dry-run continuation can never authorize mutation.
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --page-size 1
json-field next_page_token DRY
! skygo jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --page-size 1 --page-token $DRY --yes
stderr 'invalid_argument'
# One actual page removes the oldest subject and leaves a sparse first ordinal.
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --page-size 1 --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
json-field next_page_token PRUNE
# Tokens bind operation and Execute, not just the age selector.
! skygo jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --page-size 1 --page-token $PRUNE
stderr 'invalid_argument'
! skygo jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --logs-only --page-size 1 --page-token $PRUNE --yes
stderr 'invalid_argument'
skygo --json jobs list --page-size 1
jobs-exact $SECOND
json-field next_page_token NEXT
! skygo jobs retention --page-token $NEXT
stderr 'invalid_argument'
# A later insert is excluded from this already-captured highwater.
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id p4 --wait
job-id FOURTH
skygo --json jobs list --page-size 1 --page-token $NEXT
jobs-exact $THIRD
! stdout '"next_page_token"'
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *3'
skygo --json jobs list --page-size 2
jobs-exact
! stdout '"next_page_token"'
# Removing every row must not reset the sequence or resurrect an old snapshot.
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id p5 --wait
job-id FIFTH
skygo --json jobs list --page-size 1 --page-token $NEXT
jobs-exact
! stdout '"next_page_token"'
skygo --json jobs list --page-size 2
jobs-exact $FIFTH
event-count 5
server stop
! stderr .
